# Cars UA

> Look up a vehicle by Ukrainian plate number or VIN. Built on the state's open vehicle registry (data.gov.ua), with VIN decoding from NHTSA. Available in Ukrainian, Russian and English.

Individual plate and VIN result pages are per-vehicle lookups and are not meant for indexing; the pages below are the stable, citable content. The `/api/` and `/og/` paths are not for crawlers (see robots.txt).

## Guides

- [Guides](https://carsua.app/read): Cars explained on Ukrainian registry data: body types, sizes and classes, real examples.
- [Ukrainian number plates](https://carsua.app/read/plates): What a plate is made of, which letters mean which region, the old and new formats, and plates with no region.

## Statistics

- [Statistics](https://carsua.app/stats): Most common makes, colors, fuels and regions in Ukraine's vehicle registry.
- [Fuel and emissions](https://carsua.app/fuel): Fuel economy and CO2 emissions by make and model.
- [Crash safety](https://carsua.app/safety): Euro NCAP, IIHS, NHTSA and other crash-test results by make and model.
- [Ukrainian auctions](https://carsua.app/auctions): Cars and trucks from SETAM auctions of seized property in Ukraine: lots, sale prices and statistics by region, make and year.
- [Wanted vehicles](https://carsua.app/wanted): How many vehicles are wanted in Ukraine and how many were found, by region, make, colour and year.

## About

- [About](https://carsua.app/about): Where the data comes from, how search works, and what Cars UA is.
- [Privacy policy](https://carsua.app/privacy): What data we keep and what we do not collect.
- [Terms of use](https://carsua.app/terms): The rules for using Cars UA.
- [What's new](https://carsua.app/releases): A day-by-day log of Cars UA changes: features, improvements, data.
